name: Waldhof
beschreibung: The Aktivhotel Waldhof is a 4-star hotel in the hamlet of Habichen near Oetz in the Ötztal. It sits at around 850 metres above sea level at the entrance to the valley, only about 600 metres from the Hochötz-Kühtai alpine region, which invites you to ski in winter and hike in summer. The accommodation offers rooms and family apartments, an indoor pool, a sauna and a large hotel water slide. The property includes the à la carte restaurant „Tannengrün“ with traditional Tyrolean, international and seasonal cuisine, open from Thursday to Monday. Free parking, Wi-Fi and a ski room are available, and in summer there is a free mountain bike rental and guided hikes.
